title: mini-dudeai standalone config
description: Reference schema for `python3 -m mini_dudeai --config <file>`. mini-dudeai validates configs with a hand-rolled dep-free validator (validate_config); this JSON Schema documents the same shape for editors/humans. Custom source/action kinds registered via register_source()/register_action() are also accepted at runtime even though they are not enumerated here.

rules_path.description: Path to the canonical rules JSON (the daemon reads, never writes, this).

candidate_path.description: Optional path the cloud/editor writes proposed rules to; daemon validates + atomic-promotes.

state_path.description: Per-rule edge state. Defaults to rules_path + '.state'.

history_path.description: Append-only fire log. Defaults to rules_path + '.history.jsonl'.

items_path.description: Dotted path into nested JSON, e.g. 'federation.peer_status'.

state_path.description: boot_health: mini's state file (read for last_tick_ts).

sensors.description: nats_sensor: OpenClaw sensors to poll each tick; Condition emitted only while breaching.

sensor.description: Sensor label (Condition subject; the name sent to sensor_read).

tool.description: tool_exec tool; 'temperature_read' reads chip temp with no device-side registration.

token.description: nats_sensor: literal NATS auth token (prefer token_env).

token_env.description: nats_sensor: env var NAME holding the NATS auth token (keeps the secret out of this file).

actions.description: Map of action-name -> action spec. Rules reference actions by these names.

device.description: nats: default WireClaw device name (rule.action.device overrides).

payload.description: nats: default edge-up tool call; idempotent state-set tools only (gpio_write/led_set/actuator_set).

payload_down.description: nats: default edge-down tool call (e.g. relay off on recovery).

token.description: nats: literal NATS auth token (prefer token_env).

token_env.description: nats: env var NAME holding the NATS auth token.
